outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FOUR original battle-animation raster poses TWO columns TWO rows, generous empty gutters for LONG pike. Image 1 is sole identity and equipment authority: Whitepike Keeper middle-aged bearded man, blue knit cap white fur rim, cream quilted long coat and white fur mantle, gray lamellar chest/hip plates, blue scarf/tabard, gray trousers and brown leather gloves/boots. Both hands on ONE long pale wood pike, long narrow silver spearpoint and smaller silver butt spike. Same elevated three-quarter camera, body faces RIGHT. Top-left: full thrust toward screen RIGHT, leading knee bent, LEFT hand forward and RIGHT hand rear spaced apart on shaft. Crucial: full-length rear shaft and butt spike extend visibly FAR BEHIND the right elbow toward screen LEFT; do NOT truncate pike at the fist or hide its rear length. Entire point and butt visible with generous side margins. Top-right: recovery after thrust, elbows pull pike halfway back to waist, torso rises; same full-length horizontal pike remains visible both ends. Bottom-left: upright defensive-ready, feet braced, pike diagonal across chest in both hands with point to upper RIGHT and butt to lower LEFT. Bottom-right: grounded passing walk, near/right boot flat directly beneath hip bearing weight, far/left knee swings forward with boot lifted slightly, pike securely diagonal with both ends complete. Match face/costume/body scale and weapon length, no shield/extra props/extra limbs. Original painterly raster, uniform pure green #00FF00 no spill, shadow, grid, text, scenery, effects or blood.
outputs.selection_notes: 13 frames retain nine original paintings and select four new full-pike thrust, recovery, ready brace and passing-step paintings. The new thrust preserves the rear shaft and butt spike missing from the old thrust. Original equipped kneel, low fall and head-right corpse remain. Actual original alpha composites are clean and reused unchanged despite historical raw-preview rejection. New green source uses approved bounded preparation. Original scale 0.59; new horizontal attack/recovery 0.42 and enlarged lower-row guard/step 0.36, based on head/body anatomy rather than bounding-box fitting. Banded source selections preserve full pike ends while excluding neighboring leg, spearpoint and lower fragments. New travel carry points the spear opposite to the old contact carry; consistent carry/grip and a full alternating gait remain refinement, not an accepted walk. Pike length, body/palette/edge consistency and connected action/death timing remain unaccepted. Static production review is not gameplay acceptance.
